_about: Named edits to the example story's text, to test before they are made. A variant is applied to the rendered text of an edition (node scripts/story-variants.mjs render examples/story sam-first <name>), never to the records; the winner is written back as tokens by node scripts/story-variants.mjs apply. Names here are tokens, like everywhere else; they are resolved before the phrase is looked for. Names join with + on the command line.

night-in-the-time-line.about: every evening TIME line says night, so a reader who skims the time lines still knows when they are

shorter-porch.about: the porch opens with a shorter second sentence

steps.replace: It was the fourth time since the cab.
steps.with: The fourth time since the cab.

a-bill-not-invoices.about: {{theo-vance}} reads the text the way he reads a bill, not invoices; one spread holds the phrase

steps.with: the way he read a bill

rest-the-workshop.about: the reader meets {{theo-vance}} for the first time in the morning, not in the workshop at night

a-note-first.about: one line to the reader before the first spread

steps.banner: Read it in one sitting if you can: the whole story is six hours and the morning after.

the-hallway.about: a spread between the porch and the kitchen, where {{sam-hayes}} still has not looked up; a draft to test, and a slot if it wins

draft.title: The hallway
draft.picture: A narrow hallway at night, {{sam-hayes}} with one shoe off and the phone still lit in her hand, {{chloe-jenkins}} ahead of her at the kitchen door.
paragraphs: In the hallway {{sam-hayes}} took her shoes off one-handed. The phone stayed in the other hand, and she did not look up from it.
